Attached is a meeting report on a seminar organised by the China Tobacco Society
(CTS) and STMA entitled “National Seminar on Scientific and Technological
Accomplishments in the Reduction of Harmful Constituents in Cigarettes (Tobacco)"
held in Beihai, China between June 2-6, 1997, which I and C. Sun attended as
The report covers both R&D and S&H issues as reported by the representatives of
the domestic PRC industry. It is relatively comprehensive but still there is more
information, which best can be made available to those interested by meeting and
responding to questions. If you have questions or would like to discuss specific
topics further I would be available to meet with you or your colleagues.
